description: This file defines application routes and placeholder screens for a Flutter-based attendance tracking app. It includes route constants, route configuration, and minimal widget scaffolds for various screens like Login, Dashboard, Attendance, and Reports.

classes.name: AppRoutes
classes.description: Contains static route names and route configuration methods for the app, acting as a central routing utility.

classes.name: _BaseScaffold
classes.description: A reusable scaffold widget with styled container, used as a base for other screens.

classes.name: _LoginScreen
classes.description: Placeholder login screen with a button to navigate to the dashboard.

classes.name: _DashboardScreen
classes.description: Main dashboard with navigation buttons to attendance and reports screens.

methods.name: routes
methods.description: Returns a map of route names to widget builders for the application.

methods.name: onGenerateRoute
methods.description: Stub for dynamic route generation, currently returns null.
